full_name: Lyford Beveridge (brother of Lowell P. Beveridge)
notes: The 1991 contemporary obituary of Lowell Pierson Beveridge names 'a brother, Lyford Beveridge of Rockland, Maine'. This is a verified sibling relationship, but no separate vital record or identity-specific proof of Lyford's parents has been located. Do not confuse with Lyford Beverage born 1842 or assign Orris and Rose as parents by inference.
evidence_status: Siblings established by 1991 obituary; individual parentage, birth/death, and identity unresolved.

sources.title: The Rev. Lowell Beveridge, Professor of Music, Dies
sources.supports: Names Ida Gattrell Beveridge as wife; Lowell P. Beveridge Jr. and Thomas Beveridge as sons; Lyford Beveridge as surviving brother of Lowell Sr.

notes: Wife of Eliot/Elliot Beveridge of North Haven. The 2016 illustrated memoir by Lowell P. Beveridge Jr. identifies an 'Aunt Dorothy Jimmy Gattrell Beverage' beside Eliot in its page-257 caption; 1958 Calderwood diary references Eliot and Dorothy in North Haven. The exact maiden name spelling, marriage return, dates of birth and death remain to be confirmed.
evidence_status: Wife Dorothy corroborated by North Haven Historical Society biography and family memoir. The surname Gattrell and nickname 'Jimmy' are attributed to book caption, not an independently inspected marriage return.
